presets.label: Large-cap leaders
presets.what: Companies worth $10B+ that trade at least 2 million shares a day: liquid and well covered.

presets.label: Dividend payers
presets.what: Established companies ($2B+) yielding at least 3% a year. Check payout safety before trusting a high yield.

presets.label: Unusual volume
presets.what: Stocks trading at least twice their normal volume today: something is happening, so find out what.

presets.label: Low-beta defensives
presets.what: Larger companies that historically move less than the market (beta under 0.8).

presets.label: High-beta tech
presets.what: Technology companies that swing more than the market (beta over 1.5): bigger moves both ways.

presets.label: Liquid small caps
presets.what: Companies between $300M and $2B that still trade enough shares to get in and out.

presets.label: Active ETFs
presets.what: Exchange-traded funds trading at least a million shares a day.
